name: St. Joseph's College Summer 2012

venue.name: [St. Joseph's College](http://www.sjcny.edu)
venue.address: 155 West Roe Boulevard, Patchogue, New York, 11772

information: Each competitor will be charged $5 for their first event and $1 for each additional event if they preregister. Competitors who register at the door will be charged $10 and $2 for each additional event (This fee includes food for each competitor and the required WCA fee of $1 per competitor). If guests would like to be entitled to lunch also, it will be an additional $5 for each guest. Otherwise they are free to watch. Competitors must pay their fee through paypal in order to confirm their preregistration.
